title: Free Transform Distort/Envelope warp not baked into published SWF (editor-only)
description: FIXED. Root cause: compiler/characters.ts encoded obj.shape (un-warped) into DefineShape4 and ignored obj.warp; a PlaceObject matrix is affine so the non-affine distort/envelope was silently dropped at publish. Fix: added bakeWarpIntoShape() in compiler/characters.ts that reuses engine/warp.ts warpShape() (no duplicated math) to map local->absolute stage geometry then subtracts the placement offset so DefineShape stays origin-relative (PlaceObject2 tx/ty=obj.x/obj.y restores it). Applied in the main shape/drawing-object character pass AND the shape-tween morph start/end paths; handles ShapeDisplayObject + DrawingObject. Test: packages/swf/src/__tests__/warp-bake.test.ts (4 tests) compiles a warped shape via exportSWF, decodes the emitted DefineShape4 ShapeBounds from our own SWF, and asserts the warp is baked (distort drags SE corner -> xMax 5000/yMax 4000 twips vs pristine 2000/2000; envelope bowed bottom edge -> yMax>2500; plus stage warpShape() == bake+offset equivalence). RESULTS: pnpm --filter @flash/swf test --run = 111 files / 1383 tests PASS (incl. new warp-bake). pnpm --filter @flash/core test --run = 331 files / 5291 tests PASS; 3 pre-existing FAILs (writer-spec-bytes / carchive-validate-style / contents-structure / empty-bytematch) all due to missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla (task 1207), untracked & absent in both checkouts, NOT caused by this change. Build green. Docs: docs/04-toolbox.md + CLAUDE.md updated.
